name: docker-volume-runtime
goal: Run offline Linux tasks from Docker-owned workspace and Bun cache storage with bounded tmpfs, preserving task output, workspace edits and cleanup.

evidence: Benchmark #173 held-out suite overhead moved from +19.8% with binds to -13.3% with guest storage. Make the actual worker and orchestrator use a task-owned volume, guest Bun cache and bounded tmpfs with no host mount; preserve edit and checkpoint handoff.

The adapter command case previously asserted a host bind. Strengthen that same exact-argv test, plus the existing live process lifecycle case for volume policy, byte transport, workspace reconciliation, abort and cleanup.
Harness regression d035b75d1b failed the existing argv test on the host bind mount. All test and fixture bytes stay frozen for green.

Stage the disposable worktree through the daemon into a task-owned volume. Keep the original nonroot entrypoint at /workspace with bounded tmpfs. Import edits, deletions and checkpoints on exit before scoped cleanup.
